artigo.titulo: Why is my cyclamen drooping or turning yellow?

legenda: A drooping, yellowing cyclamen is rarely the end. Check the compost, the tuber and how warm the room is before you change anything.

beats.texto: 4 reasons your cyclamen is turning yellow!
Don't panic! Each one leaves different clues.
One. Soggy compost starves the roots of air.
Two. Bone-dry compost, and the whole plant flops.
Three. A dark corner, and the stalks stretch.
And the one most people miss?!
It's too warm. Move it away from the radiator.
Then check the soil first, and water round the edge.
Every cyclamen is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
